text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much for performing at our 
company's hosted event the other day!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko-san's surprise live went just as 
planned... no, even better! The crowd's 
excitement was truly incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy, thank you so much♪ It was an 
honor to be invited!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"That was a really fun event. Having 
interactive activities for the fans and 
all... That was your idea, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I thought it would be great to have 
some time to reaffirm the bond between 
artist and fans...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a wonderful perspective! I'd 
love to hear more of your passionate 
thoughts♪ Why don't we go out to celebrate 
sometime soon?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa?! N-No way, no way...! An 
after-party with "Har-pon"...?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I've been a huge fan of yours for so 
long. When I saw your Winning Live on TV, 
I broke down crying... and ever since 
then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm also in the fan club. Ah, b-but I 
make sure to switch into work mode 
properly, so—"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then it's totally fine, right?♪ An 
event producer and an idol chatting 
together... is completely normal, wouldn't 
you say?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... ........Understood! I'll look for a 
stamina-packed restaurant that 
Haiseiko-san would love!
